**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User has been doing a lot more biking lately, especially on weekends.  
[EVENT] User is looking for recommendations on biking gloves.  
[EVENT] User has not made a purchase yet for new biking gloves.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] New biking gloves can make a huge difference in your riding experience.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Top brands recommended: Pearl Izumi, Specialized, Giro, Fox Racing, Castelli.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended models:  
1. Pearl Izumi Select Gloves: $40-$60  
2. Specialized Body Geometry Gel Gloves: $40-$60  
3. Giro DND Gloves: $30-$50  
4. Fox Racing Dirtpaw Gloves: $30-$50  
5. Castelli Rosso Corsa Gloves: $60-$80  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Key features to consider: palm material, padding, breathability, fit, protection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips: try before you buy, consider your riding style, check the weather.  
[EVENT] User is interested in the Pearl Izumi Select Gloves.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pearl Izumi Select Gloves are known for comfort, grip, and durability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Durability features of Pearl Izumi Select Gloves:  
1. Palm material: Pittards WR100X, resistant to abrasion, tears, and punctures.  
2. Gel padding: absorbs vibrations and shocks.  
3. Breathable mesh: allows airflow and moisture transfer.  
4. Reinforced stitching: adds strength and durability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pearl Izumi Select Gloves are suitable for frequent weekend rides.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Expected lifespan of Pearl Izumi Select Gloves:  
- Casual riders (1-2 rides per week): 6-12 months  
- Regular riders (3-5 rides per week): 3-6 months  
- Frequent riders (daily or near-daily): 1-3 months  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pearl Izumi Select Gloves have water-resistant treatment but are not fully waterproof.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pittards WR100X palm material is water-resistant and maintains grip when wet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Breathable mesh helps reduce clamminess in wet conditions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Gloves have a waterproofing strip at the cuff to prevent water ingress.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In heavy rain, the gloves may not keep hands completely dry but will provide some protection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Care for gloves by avoiding harsh chemicals and allowing them to air dry.  
[EVENT] User is concerned about the sizing of the Pearl Izumi Select Gloves.
